notes.title: Demo Major Update 《Love n Life: Happy Student》
notes.notes:
We would like to announce that our partner, Reborn Entertainment, has released a major update to the public demo of Love n Life: Happy Student.


Love n Life: Happy Student, a unique dating sim, incorporates inventory management for the first time. As a top-scoring third-year student, you are chosen to join the most prestigious college, where you’ll meet gorgeous ladies. Discover intriguing personalities and the school’s mysteries.


:point_right: Try the updated demo now: 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3166720/"][/dynamiclink]We're proud to support creative teams like Reborn Entertainment. Don’t miss this gem!

notes.title: v1.5【Update】New Support Language Japanese and Spanish
notes.notes:
Greetings gamers!

We are thrilled to announce the release of our latest game, which now supports a brand new language - Japanese & Spanish.

We understand the importance of providing our players with the ability to enjoy our games in their native language. That's why we've tried our best to ensure that this new language is seamlessly integrated into our game, providing an immersive and enjoyable experience for all.

Whether you're a longtime fan of our games or a new player, we invite you to explore our latest release and take advantage of the new language option. Immerse yourself in our captivating storyline, and engage in exciting gameplay in your language of choice.

We're excited to continue bringing new features and updates to our games, and we hope you'll join us on this journey. So, what are you waiting for? Download the updates today and enjoy it in Japanese and Spanish!

We would like to extend a special thanks to our localization team:

 Goro = Chan
 Siodog


Happy gaming!
Secret Labo

notes.title: Development Update - November 2022
notes.notes:
1. New Feature: Hard Mode for Yokai Art

Since most of the players had completely Normal mode, this is additional content for those who want to play more and spend time in Yokai Art. We are working on balancing the Hard Mode right now.

https://i.imgur.com/X1yF6rZ.gif

2. New Feature: Formation

As mentioned in the previous updates, since we are raising the difficulty of the game, we also want to make some additional mechanics to the gameplay (which might strongly affect the current gameplay) to let you guys have more ways of beating Yokai Art. 

Currently, we have 6 types of formation which are


 3 formations that required 1 type of element to activate - Consider Normal Tier
 3 formations that required 2 type elements to activate - Consider High Tier


https://i.imgur.com/aqF475O.png

Formation unique ability: Once you unlock formation at a certain level, an additional passive ability will be added and of course, will benefit players.

Auto-populate formation: The player can preset formation and use it directly in the battle. 

https://i.imgur.com/TxCBgTV.png
https://i.imgur.com/FidnBVw.gif

3. New Feature: Additional Raijin and Fujin Unit

We decided to push up Raijin and Fujin as units that will work differently compared with others. Raijin and Fujin will have high scaling on DPS or Special ability but can only maintain in the battle for a period of time or waves. Thus, it will limit their overpower ability of them. Also, pricing will be higher as well. 

https://i.imgur.com/Rik6N6J.gif

4. Balancing: Normal Difficulty and Strategy

As per players' feedback, our gameplay currently somehow still required players to spam units as the strategy. We are still working on it making the game more strategy-oriented, and reducing boss skill damage to prevent 1 hit killing. Hope this will help new players as well as everyone who loves Yokai Art

5. Controller Support:

We are still looking into this for future plan
